symptom: Frontend HTTP 500 error rate spiked to 14.2% with server p99 latency exceeding 2800ms.
query: Online Boutique web frontend is returning HTTP 500 errors to users and p99 request latency has surged to 2800ms.
context: Runbook: Online Boutique Frontend Performance Degradation. Cause: CPU saturation on the Node.js/Go frontend container caused by template rendering bottleneck under load. Fix: 1. Verify CPU utilization with kubectl top pod. 2. Scale frontend deployment replicas. 3. Adjust container CPU limits in deployment manifest.
reference: The incident is caused by CPU saturation on the frontend service container (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total maxed out). Remediation requires scaling frontend deployment replicas and adjusting CPU limits.

telemetry.logs_summary: frontend: [ERROR] upstream request timeout while rendering product catalog page

symptom: Users cannot add items to cart; cartservice pod is restarting repeatedly with OOMKilled exit code 137.
query: Users are unable to add items to shopping cart; cartservice pod entered CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled exit code 137.
context: Runbook: CartService Redis Memory Exhaustion. Cause: cartservice container memory working set exceeded the 256Mi memory limit due to unevicted cached sessions. Fix: 1. Inspect memory usage in cartservice. 2. Configure Redis TTL and increase cartservice memory limit to 512Mi. 3. Restart cartservice pod.
reference: The cartservice failure is caused by memory exhaustion (container_memory_working_set_bytes exceeded limit), causing the container to be OOMKilled with exit code 137. Increase memory limit to 512Mi and configure session cache TTL.

telemetry.logs_summary: cartservice: System.OutOfMemoryException: Exception of type 'System.OutOfMemoryException' was thrown.
telemetry.traces_summary: trace_id=7b12f9a: /cart/add failed with RPC status UNAVAILABLE from cartservice

symptom: Checkout service RPC calls to paymentservice timing out after 3000ms with payment failure errors.
query: Checkout transactions are failing at final payment authorization due to RPC timeouts contacting paymentservice.
context: Runbook: PaymentService Network Degradation. Cause: Injected network delay or egress throttling on paymentservice veth interface. Fix: 1. Trace payment RPC spans using trace ID. 2. Verify network interface packet delay via tc qdisc. 3. Clear interface queuing discipline rules.
reference: The checkout failures are caused by severe network latency injection on the paymentservice (network_latency_ms > 3000ms), causing upstream checkout RPC timeouts. Clear tc qdisc network delay rules on the paymentservice container.

telemetry.logs_summary: checkoutservice: [WARN] PaymentService Charge RPC deadline exceeded after 3000ms
telemetry.traces_summary: trace_id=9c33d81: /checkout -> Charge RPC span duration=3050ms status=DEADLINE_EXCEEDED

symptom: Currency conversion rates failing to load; frontend displaying raw USD with intermittent connection resets.
query: Frontend currency conversion component is failing intermittently with connection resets and dropped packets.
context: Runbook: CurrencyService Network Packet Loss. Cause: High network packet drop rate on currencyservice interface. Fix: 1. Check network_transmit_packets_dropped_total. 2. Restart virtual ethernet pair on pod host. 3. Re-verify gRPC currency conversion stream.
reference: The currency conversion failures are caused by network packet loss on currencyservice (network_transmit_packets_dropped_total elevated to 40%). Reset container network interface or reschedule pod.

telemetry.logs_summary: currencyservice: [ERROR] gRPC stream reset by peer (connection dropped)
telemetry.traces_summary: trace_id=1d88e02: GetSupportedCurrencies gRPC call failed with UNAVAILABLE

symptom: Sock Shop catalogue items browsing latency increased from 40ms to 4500ms; catalogue service CPU pegged at 100%.
query: Product catalogue browsing on Sock Shop is extremely sluggish with response times over 4 seconds and catalogue container CPU at 100%.
context: Runbook: Sock Shop Catalogue CPU Saturation. Cause: Intensive unindexed MySQL queries executed by catalogue service consuming 100% container CPU. Fix: 1. Identify slow queries in catalogue-db. 2. Add composite index on category and price. 3. Scale catalogue service pod replicas.
reference: The latency spike is caused by CPU saturation on the catalogue service (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total at 100%) due to unindexed catalogue search queries. Add database indices and scale catalogue service replicas.

telemetry.logs_summary: catalogue: [WARN] SQL query execution time exceeded 3800ms for SELECT * FROM sock

symptom: Order placement is failing; orders service JVM heap memory reached 98% with frequent stop-the-world GC pauses.
query: Customers cannot complete orders on Sock Shop; orders service is throwing OutOfMemoryError and pausing during garbage collection.
context: Runbook: Sock Shop Orders Memory Leak. Cause: Unbounded queue in orders service holding order payload objects in memory. Fix: 1. Take JVM heap dump from orders container. 2. Flush uncommitted queue messages. 3. Increase JVM -Xmx heap allocation and redeploy.
reference: The order placement failures are caused by JVM heap exhaustion and memory leak in the orders service (container_memory_working_set_bytes at 98%). Increase JVM -Xmx heap limit and patch memory retention in order dispatch queue.

telemetry.logs_summary: orders: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space at OrderService.createOrder
telemetry.traces_summary: trace_id=3b99c44: POST /orders failed with HTTP 500 from orders service

symptom: Shipping address verification socket connections are being prematurely aborted with connection refused errors.
query: Shipping calculation service is rejecting incoming TCP connections with connection reset by peer on port 8080.
context: Runbook: Shipping Service Socket Aborts. Cause: File descriptor limit exhaustion or listen backlog queue full on shipping service. Fix: 1. Check ulimit -n file descriptors. 2. Increase net.core.somaxconn in container sysctl. 3. Restart shipping container.
reference: The shipping calculation failures are caused by socket connection exhaustion (tcp_socket_abort_rate spike) on the shipping service due to full listen backlog. Increase container socket backlog and ulimit descriptors.

telemetry.logs_summary: shipping: [ERROR] Failed to accept socket connection: Too many open files

symptom: User login and registration requests taking over 5000ms; user service experiencing extreme network latency.
query: User authentication and profile page loads are timing out across the Sock Shop storefront.
context: Runbook: User Authentication Latency. Cause: Network egress delay injected between front-end and user service. Fix: 1. Trace login HTTP span. 2. Verify latency on user pod interface. 3. Remove network latency delay policy.
reference: The authentication timeout is caused by network latency delay on the user service (network_latency_ms > 4500ms). Remove latency injection rule on the user service pod.

telemetry.logs_summary: front-end: [WARN] User service authentication timed out after 5000ms

symptom: Train ticket booking requests crashing with HTTP 500 and java.lang.NullPointerException in ts-order-service.
query: Train ticket booking API is failing with HTTP 500 errors and NullPointerException in ts-order-service during checkout.
context: Runbook: Train Ticket Order Service Code Fault. Cause: F2 code-level bug: uninitialized account verification object causing NullPointerException in OrderServiceImpl. Fix: 1. Inspect stack trace in ts-order-service logs. 2. Deploy hotfix ensuring null-check on Account entity before order creation. 3. Restart ts-order-service.
reference: The ticket booking crash is caused by an F2 code-level fault (NullPointerException) in ts-order-service when dereferencing an uninitialized Account object. Apply null check hotfix in OrderServiceImpl and redeploy.

telemetry.logs_summary: ts-order-service: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke 'Account.getId()' because 'account' is null at service.OrderServiceImpl.create(OrderServiceImpl.java:84)

symptom: Train route query queries taking over 6000ms; ts-travel-service experiencing high upstream RPC latency.
query: Train route search queries are hanging and timing out for passengers searching for train travel schedules.
context: Runbook: Train Ticket Travel Service Network Latency. Cause: Network latency delay on ts-travel-service veth interface causing search schedule timeouts. Fix: 1. Trace schedule query call chain. 2. Verify network interface packet delay. 3. Reset network interface traffic control rules.
reference: The travel schedule search timeouts are caused by severe network latency delay on ts-travel-service (network_latency_ms > 5000ms). Reset traffic control rules on ts-travel-service.

symptom: Authentication service threads locked at 100% CPU due to F4 infinite loop in JWT token validation.
query: Passenger login service is frozen; all ts-auth-service worker threads are stuck in an infinite loop consuming 100% CPU.
context: Runbook: Train Ticket Auth Service Infinite Loop. Cause: F4 code-level bug: malformed while loop in TokenValidator without termination condition causing worker thread starvation. Fix: 1. Take thread dump with jstack. 2. Deploy patch with proper loop termination condition in TokenValidator.java. 3. Restart ts-auth-service.
reference: The authentication outage is caused by an F4 code-level fault (infinite loop in TokenValidator) in ts-auth-service that starves worker threads at 100% CPU. Patch loop termination condition and redeploy ts-auth-service.

telemetry.logs_summary: ts-auth-service: [FATAL] Thread pool exhausted: all 64 worker threads in RUNNABLE state at TokenValidator.validate

symptom: Ticket seat availability checks failing under holiday rush; ts-ticketinfo-service CPU throttled at 100%.
query: Seat availability checks on train routes are failing with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable during holiday rush.
context: Runbook: Train Ticket TicketInfo Service CPU Throttling. Cause: High volume seat calculation algorithms saturating ts-ticketinfo-service CPU limits. Fix: 1. Check CPU throttle metric. 2. Enable horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA) for ts-ticketinfo-service. 3. Cache seat query results.
reference: The seat check failures are caused by CPU throttling on ts-ticketinfo-service (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total maxed out). Increase container CPU limits and enable HPA for ts-ticketinfo-service.

telemetry.logs_summary: ts-ticketinfo-service: [WARN] Request rejected: server thread pool queue capacity reached
